about.title: About Guillaume
about.subtitle: Operator with 10+ years of experience across e-commerce, marketplaces and international scale-ups.
about.experience: 10+ years operating in complex, high-growth environments
about.description:
I am an operator with 10+ years of experience across e-commerce, marketplaces and international scale-ups. My background combines finance, operations and systems design, with a focus on turning messy growth into structured, scalable execution.

I have operated across Rocket Internet, Jumia, Orami, Ligerio and Moverz, from multi-country restructurings to AI-driven pricing systems and logistics-heavy e-commerce scale-ups.

I am currently building Moverz and studying Computer Science / AI at Harvard to deepen the technical layer behind the systems I build.

techSection.title: My view on technology in operations
paragraphs: In most high-growth companies, the real problem is not strategy. It is execution: slow processes, scattered information, repetitive manual work, weak visibility on what is actually happening.
My view is simple: to scale durably, you need to think in systems. Where does data get lost? Which handoffs create friction? What should be automated, controlled or made visible?

I do not just recommend tools or dashboards. I design with teams a practical operating system: workflow tracking, control points, AI-enabled automation and management routines that reduce manual work and stabilize execution.

That is why I build tools myself (TypeScript, AI, automation) and study Computer Science / AI at Harvard: to connect business goals, field execution and the technical layer that truly simplifies the company.

buildSection.title: What I actually build
paragraphs: My work does not stop at recommendations. Together with teams, I build systems that run every day and make the company more reliable and measurable.
On the systems side: pricing engines, workflow automation, internal tools, KPI dashboards and operating cadences that replace manual coordination.
On the operations side: process mapping, role clarity, execution rhythms, supply/demand management and bottleneck resolution.
On AI and automation: dynamic pricing logic, computer vision pipelines, internal assistants and routines that remove manual work without adding complexity.

portfolioSection.title: Case studies
portfolioSection.intro: A few examples of what I have built, described at a non-confidential level. Context, system built, result.

items.title: Moverz — AI-driven pricing infrastructure for a €10Bn market
items.description: Built a dynamic pricing and operations engine for the fragmented European moving market. System includes: 100+ variable pricing model, computer vision (photo → inventory → price), supply-side back-office with 20+ parameters, and end-to-end workflow from qualification to booking. Result: €1M+ in customer quote requests within 3 months of launch.

items.title: Ligerio — Scaling a logistics-heavy e-commerce to €10M+
items.description: Co-founded and scaled Ligerio to €10M+ revenue in 4 years. Built the operating infrastructure that absorbed 50–100% YoY growth: logistics throughput x20, team of 40+, transition from dropshipping to consignment + warehouse model, 200k+ monthly visitors.

items.title: Rocket Internet / Jumia — Operating across 20+ entities and 550+ FTE
items.description: SWAT operator in high-risk African markets. Built finance and control functions from scratch. Led audits, restructurings and stabilizations. 22 entities, 550+ employees, 60+ direct reports across multiple countries.
